_schema.purpose: Reusable Oppr line-icon set. All icons are 24x24, stroke-only, fill:none, stroke=currentColor so they take the color you set. Use in a slide with the {{icon:NAME}} token (assemble-deck inlines the SVG). See library/icons/CLAUDE.md.

icons.name: mic
icons.description: Microphone: the operator capturing what they see.
icons.suggested_use: Capture step of Capture -> Connect -> Execute; operators are the sensor

icons.name: connect
icons.description: Two nodes on one timeline: machine data meeting operator context.
icons.suggested_use: Connect step; one timeline for machine and operator signal

icons.name: execute
icons.description: Bold check: the improvement executed as standard practice.
icons.suggested_use: Execute step; closing the loop on the floor

icons.name: loop
icons.suggested_use: the Capture -> Connect -> Execute loop; continuous improvement

icons.name: check
icons.suggested_use: a confirmed item; a recognition-checklist tick; a risk-reversal point

icons.name: check-circle
icons.description: Checkmark inside a circle: a verified result.

icons.name: target
icons.description: Concentric circles: focus on one line, one question.
icons.suggested_use: start on one line; one clear question; the proof target

icons.name: bars
icons.suggested_use: measured, repeatable improvement; KPIs and payback

icons.name: clock
icons.description: A clock face: time, the ten-week proof.
icons.suggested_use: when time matters; the ten-week proof; time to a verified improvement

icons.name: card
icons.suggested_use: a batch record; a log entry; identity

icons.name: globe
icons.description: A globe: sites and scale across the group.
icons.suggested_use: scale across lines and sites; the group

icons.name: layers
icons.description: Stacked layers: data layers on one timeline.
icons.suggested_use: machine data and operator context, layered on one timeline

icons.name: shield
icons.description: A shield: trust, safety, no rip-and-replace.
icons.suggested_use: trust and safety; no rip-and-replace; built with operators

icons.name: spark
icons.description: A small flame / droplet: a spark of insight.
icons.suggested_use: a spark of insight from the floor
